Khabburu

Biography

Khabburu is a Woodsfolk elder who remembers being imprisoned by humans and freed by another human. He urges Kir to judge individuals rather than whole peoples. His request to release caged dogs reflects the same belief that companions should choose their bonds freely. [1, 2]
